candidate.request: Show me what I spent per month in 2025.

plan.title: Spending per month
plan.question: Total spending per month in 2025, one row per month, ordered, columns month and total_eur.

candidate.sql:

FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

candidate.request: Show me the running total of our spending over the year.

plan.title: Spending so far this year
plan.question: The running total of spending per month over 2025, one row per month with the cumulative figure, columns month and cumulative_eur.

candidate.sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month

validated_sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
    SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0
  GROUP BY
    month
)
SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
